messages.subject: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hello,

We are planning a large multi-site framework booking and would like to discuss pricing. Given the volume involved, we think 22% off list rates is justified. Happy to go through the details if that helps.

Perämeren Telineet Oy

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Thank you for the enquiry. I've received your request regarding the framework pricing and will look into it. I'll be in touch once I have more to share.

Regards,
Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Jussi, could you also check if a 13-tonne excavator is available? We need to know before we finalise the site schedule.

Perämeren Telineet Oy

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hi,

I'll check the availability on the 13-tonne excavator and come back to you.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.body:
Sorry, one more thing while I have you. We got an invoice for the plate compactor we had recently and there's a charge on it I don't recognise. Can someone take a look?
